headline: Midwestern State run to six straight wins
dek: Midwestern State beat Texas A&M International for a sixth straight win and are the only side still unbeaten after ten matches. St. Mary's kept pace with a win at Sul Ross State, who have yet to score a goal this season.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Ten different players have scored Midwestern State's 28 goals, and Parker Plaxco has eight of them.

wire.line: Midwestern State have scored 28 goals and conceded seven in an unbeaten season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, UT Dallas's at Ouachita Baptist, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State have lost all seven of their matches, conceding 30 goals and scoring none.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have won six, drawn two and lost one, and their nineteen goals are more than St. Edward's and West Texas A&M have scored together.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Tyler have drawn four of their eight matches, more draws than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jake Morris has conceded seven goals for Midwestern State and kept four shutouts.

last_match.line: Midwestern State remain the conference's only unbeaten side; Texas A&M International have yet to score in conference play.

next_match.line: UT Tyler have drawn more matches than any other programme in the conference; Midwestern State have not lost this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
